name: payment-collections-api

dependencies.name: payment-gateway
dependencies.description: Records collections notified by the gateway and calls it to disburse each merchant's net settlement.

dependencies.name: merchant-identity-service
dependencies.description: Checks a merchant's trading status and payout account before including them in a settlement run.

description: Aggregates merchant collections from mobile money and card, keeps the double-entry ledger, runs the fixed daily settlement cadence (netting fees, gating on trading status, disbursing through the payment gateway), and serves the merchant portal's own-data views and in-app notifications. Does not own merchant identity, trading eligibility, payout account or credit limit, and never converts between currencies.
